findings.description: Direct inspection of the V89 sit and crouch renders shows both upper thighs remain largely exposed; the remaining white crotch panel reads as a brief-like patch rather than continuous fitted shorts. Current posed surface-ray diagnostics report only 16.27% under-shorts thigh coverage in sit and 24.07% in crouch on each side. The bilateral surface-placement step moved 545 vertices per thigh but did not create a continuous wearable shorts shell.

Neutral, sit, and crouch renders show the under-shorts fail to cover the thighs continuously and do not form a coherent crotch join. In sit and crouch, the front patch hangs between the legs and the body surfaces remain visible; no fit or deformation acceptance is granted.

Direct front, back, left, right, and three-quarter inspection shows strong accordion-like side corrugation, projecting corners, and a much lower front panel. Sit and crouch add sharp triangular splay and the skirt opens around the thighs instead of deforming coherently.

The V89 geometry/build audit still does not verify avatar fit. The bilaterally projected rest-pose surface shell is a construction experiment only; skin weights, shape-key response, UV, Unity prefab, and VRChat execution remain unverified and cannot be inferred from these renders.

nextAction: Keep V89 rejected. Replace the current narrow patch panels with a continuous shorts shell generated around each posed thigh surface and connected through an integrated crotch gusset; validate the assembled silhouette rather than only moving existing panel vertices. Rework the overskirt side folds and hem transitions, then rerun the canonical build, post-skin audit, all required pose renders, and direct review. Do not publish or release this prototype.
